chapterInfo.content:
55
Onyankopɔn dom frɛ
1 # Yoh 7.37; Adi 22.17 Mommra oo, mo a sukɔm de mo nyinaa,
mommra nsuo ho,
na mo a monni sika no,
mommra mmɛtɔ, na monni.
Mommra mmɛtɔ nsa ne nufosuo;
ɛnyɛ sika na wɔde tɔ, na ɛnni boɔ nso.
2Adɛn na mokari sika gye deɛ ɛnyɛ aduane,
ne mo brɛ so adeɛ tɔ deɛ ɛmmee mo?
Montie me ɛ, monni nnepa,
na sradeduane nyɛ mo kra dɛ.
3 # Yer 31.31-34; Dwom 89.2-4; Aso 13.34 Monyɛ aso ɛ, na mommra me nkyɛn,
montie, na mo kra nnya nkwa.
Na me ne mo bɛpam daa apam,
Dawid adɔeɛyɛdeɛ a ɛsi hɔ pintinn no.
4Hwɛ, mede no mayɛ aman danseni,
aman safohene ne mmarahyɛni.
5Hwɛ, wobɛfrɛ ɔman a wonni wɔn aba,
na aman a wɔnni woɔ no de mmirika bɛba wo nkyɛn,
AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nti ne Israel Kronkronni no nti,
ɛfiri sɛ wahyɛ wo animuonyam.
6 # Yer 29.13 Monhwehwɛ AWURADE, berɛ a ɔma wɔhu no no,
momfrɛ no berɛ a ɔbɛn no.
7 # Hes 33.11; Dwom 130.4 Ma ɔbɔnefoɔ nnane ne kwan nnya,
na onipa huhuo nnane n’adwene nnya,
na ɔnsane mmra AWURADE nkyɛn, na ne yam bɛhyehye no ama no,
ne yɛn Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn, na ne fakyɛ a ɔde bɛkyɛ dɔɔso.
8Na ɛnyɛ m’adwene ne mo adwene,
na ɛnyɛ mo akwan ne m’akwan, AWURADE asɛm nie;
9 # Dwom 92.5 na sɛdeɛ ɔsoro korɔn sene asase no,
saa ara na m’akwan korɔn sene mo akwan,
na m’adwene nso sene mo adwene.
10Na sɛdeɛ osuo ne sukyerɛmma firi soro gu fam
na ɛnsane nkɔ hɔ bio, gye sɛ ɛfɔ asase ansa
ma no ba aduane na ɛso aba,
na ɛde aba ma ogufoɔ ne aduane ma odifoɔ no,
11 # Mat 13.8 saa ara na m’asɛm a ɛfiri m’anomu bɛyɛ:
Ɛrensane mma me nkyɛn kwa,
na mmom gye sɛ ɛyɛ deɛ mepɛ
na ɛwie deɛ enti a mesomaa no no.
12 # Yes 44.23 Na anigyeɛ na mode bɛfiri akorɔ,
na wɔde asomdwoeɛ agya mo kwan.
Mo nti mmepɔ ne nkokoɔ bɛto anigyeɛ dwom prɛko pɛ,
na wiram nnua nyinaa abobɔ wɔn nsam.
13Pepeaa bɛfifiri asi nkasɛɛ ananmu,
na ohwamdua bɛfifiri akraateɛ ananmu;
na ɛbɛyɛ din ama AWURADE
ne daa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔrentwa ntwene.

mommra nsuo ho,

Mommra mmɛtɔ nsa ne nufosuo;
ɛnyɛ sika na wɔde tɔ, na ɛnni boɔ nso.
Adɛn na mokari sika gye deɛ ɛnyɛ aduane,

na aman a wɔnni woɔ no de mmirika bɛba wo nkyɛn,
AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nti ne Israel Kronkronni no nti,
ɛfiri sɛ wahyɛ wo animuonyam.

Monhwehwɛ AWURADE, berɛ a ɔma wɔhu no no,
momfrɛ no berɛ a ɔbɛn no.
Ma ɔbɔnefoɔ nnane ne kwan nnya,
na onipa huhuo nnane n’adwene nnya,
na ɔnsane mmra AWURADE nkyɛn, na ne yam bɛhyehye no ama no,
ne yɛn Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn, na ne fakyɛ a ɔde bɛkyɛ dɔɔso.
Na ɛnyɛ m’adwene ne mo adwene,
na ɛnyɛ mo akwan ne m’akwan, AWURADE asɛm nie;
na sɛdeɛ ɔsoro korɔn sene asase no,

na ɛde aba ma ogufoɔ ne aduane ma odifoɔ no,
saa ara na m’asɛm a ɛfiri m’anomu bɛyɛ:
Ɛrensane mma me nkyɛn kwa,

Na anigyeɛ na mode bɛfiri akorɔ,
na wɔde asomdwoeɛ agya mo kwan.
Mo nti mmepɔ ne nkokoɔ bɛto anigyeɛ dwom prɛko pɛ,

Pepeaa bɛfifiri asi nkasɛɛ ananmu,
na ohwamdua bɛfifiri akraateɛ ananmu;

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
